historical_commentary.text: The core technique — using 4D's Object and Collection types as associative (key-value) in-memory structures — remains fully current and is widely used in modern 4D code, including as the backbone of ORDA entity/collection handling. No later 4D feature has deprecated or replaced this pattern, so despite the missing full text, the topic itself is safely assessed as still relevant today.
related_updates: Object/Collection-based associative arrays remain a standard, current 4D technique.
